test_suites.covers: PR10 semantic benchmark workload/result/evidence-anchor schema validation (round-trip, kind contracts, strata, digests, 10x chunk-multiplier), and the CalibratedSemanticQueryService retrieval contract: every non-ready semantic index state (Unavailable/Indexing/Degraded/Failed/Stale/Incompatible) preserves byte-identical PR9 fallback under FallbackAllowed and returns a typed StrictUnavailable error under StrictSemantic. Non-ready semantic lanes are never invoked.

PR10 vector generation: embedding projection-key completeness/determinism and Plan-25 mapping, projection+privacy authority, canonical-chunk fake projection with Plan-25 receipts, atomic checkpoint/active-pointer publication, unchanged-generation vector reuse without re-inference, fail-closed rejection of invalid fake vectors and key-only reuse, duplicate-row rejection without advancing the checkpoint, and generation-identity equality across single- vs multi-batch publications. Uses the deterministic fake projector; no model inference or vector download.

PR10 FastEmbed local-artifact runtime: signed-manifest round-trip/canonical-digest/validator rules, trust-root resolution (release vs local, expiry/revocation/retirement windows), artifact-store atomic signature-verified import, model catalog (default Jina code model pinned, unknown rejected), session pool lifecycle (reuse, reaping, memory/hard-session ceilings, identity/privacy separation, FIFO waiter queue, cancellation, typed non-blocking exhaustion), runtime-query saturation/omission and atomically-current-generation binding, async reload atomic swap, and the deterministic fake embedder. One source-inspection test asserts the production runtime initializes FastEmbed via `try_new_from_user_defined(` (verified local bytes), never `TextEmbedding::try_new(` (download constructor), never falls back to `FakeEmbeddingRuntime`, uses no network/ambient-cache surface (reqwest/ureq/hf_hub/HF_*/FASTEMBED_CACHE_*), and that the artifact store does not publish `activate(`. No network and no model download; the real FastEmbed constructor is asserted present by source inspection, not executed.

PR9/PR10 candidate producers and single-root fusion over the real sanitized fixtures: exact-admission authority classification and authority-minted proofs, fielded BM25 whole-term/subtoken distinction, deterministic phrase and bounded-fuzzy recovery, freshness coverage and page cutoff, CompositionKernel fusion with score-domain calibration profiles across exact/lexical/graph lanes with graph complete/denied/unavailable dispositions and late hydration, plus fixture integrity, contamination-partition disjointness (22 development / 9 sealed-holdout queries, 10 corpus snapshots), and the evaluator compare/ablation contract. Exercises the production CompositionKernel and calibration path directly.

tracedecay-search-eval CLI: validate reports frozen fixture/run/holdout digests without emitting outputs; compare is contract_only-blocked (exit 3) and writes an immutable, append-only, no-promotion report that supersedes by revision; invalid run manifests fail (exit 2) before opening any holdout labels; CLI help exposes no packet/seal/owner surface.
Sealed-holdout authority: holdout labels remain sealed and are not accessible through the contract-only evaluation path.

test_side_repair.change: Hardened the `production()` source-extraction helper in `semantic_runtime_uses_verified_fastembed_bytes_without_network_or_fallback`. The helper split the file at the first `#[cfg(test)]` string to drop test scaffolding, but production code added a `#[cfg(test)] use std::sync::Arc;` inline import among the top-of-file use statements, which truncated the inspected source and hid the real production FastEmbed constructor, failing the positive `try_new_from_user_defined(` assertion. The helper now strips single-line `#[cfg(test)]`-guarded use imports before locating the scaffolding boundary.
test_side_repair.classification: Test-helper fragility, not a product regression: the product source still initializes FastEmbed via try_new_from_user_defined, still has no TextEmbedding::try_new download constructor, and still confines FakeEmbeddingRuntime to #[cfg(test)].
